fields.description: Warn lets a session with unresolved blockers be completed. Block refuses it unless a reason is recorded on the encounter.
fields.label: Blocker Enforcement

fields.description: An open follow-up ToDo turns a blocker into a warning.
fields.label: An Open ToDo Downgrades A Blocker

fields.description: Warn when a lot expires within this many days. 0 turns the warning off.
fields.label: Expiring Soon (Days)

fields.description: Features that are not finished. Leave off unless the integration behind them is configured.
fields.label: Incomplete Features

fields.description: Show the WhatsApp send, resend and cancel actions on the Consent tab.
fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Consent

fields.description: Show the lab case actions on procedure rows.
fields.label: Enable Lab Cases

fields.description: Show the Sync Billables action.
fields.label: Enable Billing Sync

fields.description: The Rx tab shows each linked item's stock in this warehouse.
fields.label: Prescription Warehouse
Voice AI Scribe
fields.description: Records the consultation from the Derma Chart, transcribes it (English/Arabic) and drafts the note and letters with an AI model. The doctor reviews before saving. Provider: SOULVD AI Gateway (one key, metered) or direct provider keys.

fields.label: Enable Voice AI Scribe
fields.description: Shows the Dictate button on the Assessment tab. Keys may also come from site_config (same names).

fields.label: Speech-to-Text Model
fields.description: Leave empty for scribe_v1.

fields.label: LLM Base URL
fields.description: Leave empty for OpenAI (https://api.openai.com/v1). Also: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 or the SOULVD AI Gateway https://gateway.soulvd.com/v1. site_config applies when empty.

fields.label: LLM Model
fields.description: Leave empty for gpt-4o.

fields.label: Speech-to-Text Base URL
fields.description: Leave empty for ElevenLabs (https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1). SOULVD AI Gateway: https://gateway.soulvd.com/v1 with the SOULVD key in both key fields. site_config keys of the same name apply when empty.

fields.label: Max Recording (minutes)
fields.description: Recording stops itself at this length.

fields.label: Keep Audio (days)
fields.description: 0 keeps recordings forever. Otherwise the nightly job deletes consultation audio older than this (in the Recording Storage Folder too); transcripts and notes stay.

fields.label: Recording Storage Folder
fields.description: Absolute folder on the hospital server (a local disk or a mounted NAS), e.g. /mnt/recordings. Each recording is saved as <folder>/<patient>/<date>/consultation-<visit>-<time>.wav and the path is noted on the visit. Leave empty to keep recordings as private files on the visit.

fields.label: Let the AI create missing Complaint / Diagnosis records
fields.description: Off: a dictated symptom or diagnosis fills the Structured tab only when it already exists in your master list; anything unmatched goes into Symptoms Notes / Diagnosis Note as text. On: the missing master is created automatically.

fields.label: Learn each doctor's writing style
fields.description: Once a day, compares AI drafts with the notes doctors kept and suggests writing rules in Derma Style Rule. Edited notes are sent to the AI provider for this, with the patient's name removed. Nothing changes until someone sets a rule to Active.
